name: Kiyohara no Fukayabu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 36); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: Too short the lovely summer night
poems.author: Kiyohara no Fukayabu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 36
poems.text:
Too short the lovely summer night,
Too soon ’tis passed away;
I watched to see behind which cloud
The moon would chance to stay,
And here’s the dawn of day!
